design_notes: Use serif throughout; single accent colour (e.g. deep blue).
Tables: hairline rules, alternating row shading optional.
Pull quote: larger serif italic, centred, with a thin rule above and below.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three numbers, growth bars proportional to value, split bar for organised vs unorganised.
Sidebar: boxed with light background, no icon.
